action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

app_path.description: For 'launch': path to the built .app bundle (e.g. DerivedData/.../Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app).

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000, total clamped to 30s).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000, total clamped to 30s).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

url.description: For 'open_url': URL or scheme to open in the simulator.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

widget_code.description: SVG or HTML code to render. For SVG: raw SVG code starting with <svg> tag, must use CSS variables for colors. Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

The call ends your run, so do everything else first and put everything your caller needs in that one report. It is not a messaging channel: do not use it for progress updates or questions.

Only a report delivered through SubagentHandback reaches your caller; plain text you write at the end of your run is NOT delivered. There is no recipient parameter: the report can only go to your caller.

entries.description:
Fetches a URL, converts the page to markdown, and answers `prompt` against it using a small fast model.

- Fails on authenticated/private URLs — use an authenticated MCP tool or `gh` for those instead. claude.ai artifact links (claude.ai/artifact/{id} or claude.ai/code/artifact/{uuid}) are published artifacts: read them with the Artifact tool (action "read"), not WebFetch or curl.
- Fails on localhost and other hostnames without a dot; for a local server, use curl via Bash.
- HTTP is upgraded to HTTPS. Cross-host redirects are returned to you rather than followed; call again with the redirect URL.
- Responses are cached for 15 minutes per URL.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from

prompt.description: The prompt to run on the fetched content

offset.description: Character position in the page text to start reading from. Use it to read on through a page too long for one call, with the value the previous result gave.

entries.description:
Search the web. Returns result blocks with titles and URLs. US-only.

- The current month is (provided in the conversation below) — use this when searching for recent information.
- `allowed_domains` / `blocked_domains` filter results.
- After answering from results, end with a "Sources:" list of the URLs you used as markdown links.

allowed_domains.description: Only include search results from these domains

blocked_domains.description: Never include search results from these domains

mode.description: "standard": the normal web search: quick and cheap; right for straightforward lookups (reference facts, official pages, documentation, well-known people, places and topics) and simple follow-up lookups. "extended": a thorough, fresh search at several times the cost and latency.

Chery launched the upgraded 2024 Arrizo 8 in China on June 16, 2024, with three new trims priced from 122,900 to 148,900 yuan. The biggest upgrade was pairing the 2.0T model with Chery's self-developed 8AT gearbox, while the 1.6T model received a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8155 chip.

**Powertrain**
- The 2.0T engine replaced the older 7DCT with Chery's self-developed Fuzhen 8AT gearbox. Chery said this was the first 8AT gearbox it developed independently in China and built in large volume.
- The 2.0T produces 187 kW (254 hp) and 390 Nm of peak torque. The 1.6T outputs 145 kW (194 hp) and 290 Nm and uses a 7-speed DCT.
- The 2.0T gets a new "Yu+" trim at 148,900 yuan, and the 1.6T gained "Zhi" and "Rui" trims at 122,900 and 128,900 yuan.

**Technology and interior**
- The biggest interior change was a standard Qualcomm Snapdragon 8155 chip on the 1.6T trim.
- Voice control now handles trunk operation, and the passenger seat gets four-way electric adjustment.
- The cockpit uses a 24.6-inch dual screen (12.3-inch LCD instrument panel plus 12.3-inch central screen) and a flat-bottom steering wheel.
- Higher trims add a 12-speaker Sony audio system, ambient lighting, a heated steering wheel, and heated seats.

**Driver assistance**
- The sedan adds advanced driver assistance covering lane departure assist, lane change assist, front and rear collision warning, door opening warning, traffic sign recognition, adaptive cruise control, and automatic emergency braking.

**Exterior**
- The design keeps the Art in Motion language, with a large trapezoidal grille and sharp headlights.
- The new trims ride on 18-inch multi-spoke wheels. A new Crystal Gray color was added for the 1.6T trim.
- Dimensions are 4780/1843/1469 mm, with a 2790 mm wheelbase.

**Discrepancies between sources**
- One outlet says the 1.6T has a Snapdragon 855 rather than 8155 ([voi.id](https://voi.id/en/mobil/391522)). The 8155 figure appears in the majority of reports, so it is likely the correct one.
- Some sources describe the 8AT as a Chery first, while others only say it is the first domestically produced transmission developed fully in-house. Both point to the same gearbox.

- **September 2022:** Arrizo 8 launches on the Chinese market.
- **2023 Shanghai Auto Show:** The PHEV version (codenamed M1E-PHEV) debuts as the Arrizo 8 C-DM.
- **October 2023:** Chery teases the Fulwin A8, which is the renamed Arrizo 8 C-DM. The page calls it "Fulwin A8" throughout. The "Fengyun A8" name appears only in a 2023 reference headline saying the PHEV might be renamed that. Fulwin is the English form of Fengyun.

**1. Third-generation CS75 PLUS Champion Edition** (3 variants, 121,900–139,900 RMB)
- Standard L2 driver-assist suite, including adaptive cruise, forward collision warning, and lane-keeping.

- 上市前的预售阶段,报道给出的价格区间是14.99万元起,与正式上市时的起售价存在差异。该车已开启预售,预售价格区间为14.99...
- 配置方面,将搭载Lion4.0+雄狮智云车机系统,配备12扬声器SONY高保真音响系统、方向盘电加热、64色律动氛围灯等配置。
- 外观上,车头格栅增加了镀铬装饰条,车尾采用贯穿式尾灯组。车身尺寸为4780×1890×1730mm,轴距2800mm。

**2024款与2025款(2024年)**
- 2024年5月,星途凌云王者版正式上市,新车共推出2款车型,售价分别为12.99万和13.99万元。
- 2025款于2024年7月18日上市,提供4款配置车型,售价12.99-16.99万元。年度改款主要调整了车型数量、功能配置和售价,其中四驱国际版降价2万元。
- 动力方面,继续提供1.6T+7DCT与2.0T+8AT两种组合,其中2.0T搭配8AT变速箱的版本被报道为升级车型。
- 内饰上,内置经过升级的雄狮智云Lion5.0系统,支持华为Hicar4.0等功能,并由高通骁龙8155芯片提供支持。新增的沐光橙内饰配有NAPPA真皮座椅。

**后续改款(2025年9月)**
- 2025年9月9日,星途凌云曜夜版正式上市,指导价格区间为14.99-16.99万元,新增鎏光金外观车色和月影棕内饰配色,并在配置方面进行了升级。

**小结**
如果你关心的是2023年和2024年的新款,对应的是2023年7月的中期改款(13.99-17.79万元)与2024年7月的2025款(12.99-16.99万元)。2025年9月的曜夜版售价为14.99-16.99万元。需要注意的是,搜索结果中的数据主要来自汽车之家、搜狐汽车等媒体报道,具体配置和价格请以星途官方或当地经销商的最新信息为准。

**奇瑞艾瑞泽8 PRO（2025年3月首发的1.6T版本）概况**

**上市日期**
- 官方最初安排的上市日是3月25日。3月1日,奇瑞艾瑞泽8 PRO正式开启预售,当时写明将于3月25日上市。
- 后续报道显示实际提前到了3月22日。3月22日,奇瑞艾瑞泽8 PRO正式上市,共推出4款车型。因此首发日期以3月22日为准。

**售价**
- 预售价为11.99-13.59万元。
- 正式上市指导价为11.69至13.29万元,限时红包价为10.39至11.99万元。具体来看,标准型11.69万元、舒适型12.29万元、豪华型12.89万元、豪华型+13.29万元(红包价分别为10.39、10.99、11.59、11.99万元),数据来自汽车之家的上市报道。

**配置与动力**
- 外观采用家族化前脸和八边形格栅,并换装全新的双色多辐轮圈。
- 内饰方面,配备15.6英寸中控屏,全系配备8155芯片,支持全域车机互联,并标配50W无线手机充电。
- 前排座椅配有通风、腰托和按摩功能,并配有电动尾门。
- 动力为1.6T发动机,最大功率145kW,最大扭矩290N·m,匹配7挡双离合变速箱。

**后续变化（供参考）**
- 2.0T版本于2025年6月19日上市。新车共计推出2款车型,售价13.79-14.99万元,动力为最大功率达到 187kW,最大扭矩为 390N・m。
- 1.6T版本在6月也有降价,618狂欢价10.19-11.79万元。

- 有一条汽车之家问答页面称该车"2023年12月上市、指导价14.79万元",与上述2025年3月的官方报道不一致,可能是其他车型或信息有误,未采纳。
- 价格为上市时的指导价和促销价,具体请以当地经销商报价为准。

- 奇瑞官方于2023年6月12日宣布新款艾瑞泽5 PLUS上市，首批推出3款车型，售价区间为7.49-8.99万元。作为改款车型，2023款艾瑞泽5 PLUS在外观、内饰和配置上均有不同程度的优化升级，并且依旧提供1.5L或1.5T两种动力选择。
- 首批车型指导价为：1.5L-CVT PLUS 7.49万元、1.5L-CVT 享PLUS 7.99万元、1.5T-CVT 享PLUS 8.99万元。新车将会提供比较丰富的标配，包括自动大灯、外后视镜电动调节、倒车雷达、倒车影像(高配为360°全景影像)、疲劳驾驶提示、自动驻车、一键启动、无钥匙进入、定速巡航、10.25英寸中控屏等。
- 上市前，6月8日，我们从官方获悉，奇瑞旗下新款艾瑞泽5 PLUS将于6月12日上市。

**配置细节**
- 中高配车型配备10.25英寸液晶仪表，高配车型集成了雄狮智云系统，支持远程控制、语音控制以及在线音乐、新闻、天气等功能（来源同上，6-1）。

**后续新增车型**
- 上市两天后，艾瑞泽5 PLUS新增3款配置车型，售价区间为10.69-11.99万元，提供了更多配置选择，价格也相较于6月12日上市的三款车型更高。 新增款包括1.5L-CVT新动版、酋长青春版和酋长运动版。

**上市概况**

**Launch date:** The updated SL03 BEV was announced on February 20, 2024. The original SL03 launched on July 25, 2022.

**Key changes from the previous version:**

- **Pricing:** The entry price fell by RMB 7,000, from RMB 163,900 to RMB 156,900 (about $21,820). Buyers also get a RMB 10,000 cash discount, or RMB 6,000 cash plus a RMB 6,000 option fund.
- **Lineup:** Three versions are offered, starting at RMB 156,900, RMB 163,900, and RMB 173,900. The previous model had two, starting at RMB 163,900 and RMB 191,900.
- **Entry-version range:** The lower-priced versions have a 58.89 kWh battery and a 530 km CLTC range, up from 515 km.
- **Top-version range:** The highest-priced version has a 66.8 kWh battery and a 610 km CLTC range. The previous top version had 705 km, so its range is lower.
- **Performance:** The lower versions have 160 kW peak power and reach 100 km/h in 6.9 seconds. The top version has 190 kW and reaches 100 km/h in 6.2 seconds. The article doesn't give the previous model's power or acceleration figures.

**Launch date:** December 2, 2024, when Avatr rolled out the updated Avatr 11.

**Key features:**

- **Powertrains:** The SUV now comes as both extended-range (EREV) and battery-electric (BEV) models. There are two EREV variants, starting at RMB 279,900 (about $38,480) and RMB 299,900. The three BEV variants start at RMB 339,900, RMB 369,900, and RMB 429,900.
- **EREV battery:** CATL's Freevoy hybrid battery has a 39.05 kWh capacity and a 225 km electric range. It supports a 3C peak charge rate and charges from 30% to 80% in 15 minutes.
- **EREV range and system:** The EREV uses Avatr's Kunlun extended-range system, which has a claimed CLTC range of up to 1,065 km with a full tank and full charge. Avatr says the battery works between -35°C and 65°C.
- **EREV performance:** Both EREV variants are single-motor, rear-wheel drive. They reach 100 km/h from a standstill in 6.9 seconds and have a 200 km/h top speed.
- **BEV battery and range:** The BEVs use a CATL lithium-ion ternary pack, listed as 116.79 Wh, which is likely a typo for kWh. The single-motor rear-wheel-drive version has a CLTC range of up to 815 km. The two dual-motor all-wheel-drive versions have a CLTC range of 760 km.
- **BEV drivetrain:** The BEVs use Huawei's latest DriveONE 800V silicon carbide electric drive system. The all-wheel-drive version reaches 100 km/h in 3.9 seconds.
- **Dimensions:** The SUV is 4,895 mm long, 1,970 mm wide, and 1,601 mm tall, with a 2,975 mm wheelbase.

The article doesn't mention an ADS (driver-assistance) version or a cockpit chip for the updated Avatr 11. It only notes that the original 2022 model came with Huawei's full-stack smart car solution as standard.
